items.prompt: A solver stops after tiny objective changes. What evidence would you require before calling the result optimal?
items.modelAnswer: Check the stop status/budget, feasibility, derivative correctness and scaling, an appropriate gradient/projected/KKT residual, convexity/global-optimality conditions or bounded claims, and reference cases. Separate numerical solution from model validity and action authority.

criteria.text: Checks feasible residuals under explicit assumptions.
Avoids a model or action guarantee from status alone.
